title: Data Gathering Pipeline
purpose: Standardize how research data flows from gathering through processing to storage. Ensures all research is deduplicated, quality-checked, properly tagged, and indexed before being committed to the knowledge base.

pre_research_checklist.title: Pre-Research Checklist
pre_research_checklist.overview: Before gathering any new data, verify what already exists and define the scope of research.

steps.action: Search existing KB entries for the topic using unified_search.py
steps.rationale: Avoid duplicating research that already exists. If a relevant entry exists, extend it rather than creating a new one.

steps.action: Check the relationship graph for related entries that might contain relevant data
steps.rationale: Related entries may contain partial answers or complementary data that reduces the scope of new research needed.

steps.action: Define the research scope and expected output format

output.expected_format: KB entry | source definition | script | market-research pick
output.estimated_sources: Number of sources expected to consult
output.time_budget: Maximum time to spend gathering before switching to synthesis

steps.action: Assign canonical tags from taxonomy.json BEFORE research starts
rules: Select 3-6 tags from storage/taxonomy.json
All tags must be canonical (not aliases). Use the consolidations map to resolve aliases.
Tags must span at least 2 different namespaces (e.g., one domain + one task)
Pre-assigning tags focuses the research and prevents scope creep
steps.command: Review storage/taxonomy.json tags array for valid canonical tag names

research_execution.title: Research Execution
research_execution.overview: Gather data using parallel sub-agents, each returning structured findings.

steps.action: Dispatch sub-agents for parallel web search following SOP-022 sub-agent patterns
rules: Each sub-agent gets a distinct search facet (e.g., one searches documentation, another searches academic papers, another searches community discussions)
Limit to 3-5 parallel agents to avoid redundant coverage
Each agent must have a clear, non-overlapping scope

steps.action: Each agent returns structured JSON with standardized fields

output_format.key_finding: One-paragraph summary of the relevant information found
output_format.relevance_score: 0.0-1.0 score indicating how relevant this finding is to the research question
output_format.date_accessed: YYYY-MM-DD date the source was accessed
output_format.source_type: documentation | paper | forum | blog | official-api | dataset

steps.action: Merge findings from all agents using the merge_research.py pattern
steps.technique: Collect all agent outputs, sort by relevance_score descending, group by theme

steps.action: Deduplicate merged findings using TF-IDF similarity
rules: Similarity threshold: 0.65 (findings above this are considered duplicates)
When duplicates are found, keep the finding with the higher relevance_score
Log all removed duplicates for audit trail

quality_gate.title: Quality Gate
quality_gate.overview: Grade the research output before committing it to storage. Research that does not meet the quality threshold must be improved.

steps.action: Grade research output using grade_research.py across 5 dimensions

dimensions.completeness: Does the research answer the original question fully? (0-20)
dimensions.accuracy: Are findings from reliable, authoritative sources? (0-20)
dimensions.recency: Are findings current and not outdated? (0-20)
dimensions.diversity: Do findings come from multiple independent sources? (0-20)
dimensions.actionability: Can the findings be directly used or do they need further work? (0-20)

steps.action: Evaluate the quality score against the minimum threshold
steps.if_fails: Identify which dimensions scored lowest and dispatch targeted follow-up agents

steps.action: If below threshold: dispatch targeted follow-up research
rules: Only re-research the weakest dimensions (e.g., if recency scored low, search for more recent sources)
Follow-up agents use the same structured output format as the original agents
Maximum 2 follow-up rounds. If still below threshold after 2 rounds, proceed with a quality warning annotation.
Re-run the quality gate after each follow-up round

storage_and_indexing.title: Storage & Indexing
storage_and_indexing.overview: Commit the quality-checked research to the knowledge base with proper metadata, tags, and index updates.

steps.action: Create a KB entry using the standard TEMPLATE.md format
rules: Use the pre-assigned canonical tags from the Pre-Research Checklist
Include 3-6 tags, all from taxonomy.json canonical names
Set the category field to match one of the categories in taxonomy.json
Include source URLs in the references section

steps.action: Set builds_on references to related entries discovered in the pre-research checklist
rules: Reference any entries found in step 1-2 of the Pre-Research Checklist
Only reference entries that this new entry genuinely extends or depends on
Do not create circular references

steps.action: Update knowledge-base/index.json with the new entry
updates_required: Add entry to the entries array with id, title, file, category, tags, created date
Add entry ID to the appropriate categories array
Add entry ID to each relevant tag in the tag_index

steps.action: Rebuild the unified search index
Verify no new orphan nodes in the relationship graph
steps.expected: Orphan count should not increase. If it does, add builds_on references to connect the new entry.

verification.title: Verification
verification.overview: Run all validators to confirm the new entry is structurally sound and discoverable.

steps.action: Run fast_validate to check structural integrity of all indexes
steps.expected: All checks pass with no errors

steps.action: Run kb_validator.py on the new entry specifically
steps.expected: Entry passes all validation rules (valid tags, valid category, valid builds_on references)

steps.action: Test that unified_search.py can find the entry by its tags
steps.expected: The new entry appears in search results

steps.action: Verify the relationship graph shows expected connections
steps.expected: Node exists in the graph with correct builds_on edges

per_research_task: Searched existing KB for prior work on this topic
Checked relationship graph for related entries
Defined research scope and expected output format
All agent outputs use structured JSON format
Created KB entry using TEMPLATE.md format
Set builds_on references to related entries
Verified no new orphans in relationship graph
